title: Breakable by Elliot
author: Elliot Van Strydonck
description: Here, I open up about topics that are too often left in the shadow—those profound, sometimes taboo subjects that impact our mental health and physical development. By speaking with insightful guests and sharing authentic stories, I aim to break down barriers, offer support, and inspire meaningful change. Whether you’re striving for mental clarity, emotional resilience, or physical vitality, my goal is to provide a safe space and open discussion for exploration and growth. Together, we can navigate the complexities of personal development and discover new pathways to a healthier, more fulfilled life.
